messages.content: Hi there! Can you please check my account, user_1234, for any available coupons? I’m currently browsing the electronics category and looking at the black Sony XM5 headphones (p_sony_xm5_blk), but I’d like you to find some similar alternative products for me first. From those recommendations, please select and reserve a quantity of 1 unit of the silver Sony WH-1000XM5. After that, go ahead and confirm the order for that reservation using my credit_card as the payment method. Once the order is finished, please analyze the confirmation status to create a "Purchase Summary" document with the result. Finally, could you also look up the latest business news for me? Thanks!
